scope: Bounded read-only visual review of actual captured site images; no browser actions, code changes, operators, production calls, credentials or account submission. DOM facts are corroborating root capture metadata, separate from screenshot inspection.
captureProvenance: Root Tab.screenshot + browser viewport for initial16 and three timeout states; replacement light375 timeout used getScreenshot after viewport reset/resize/reload. Files have .png names but contain JPEG/JFIF bytes.
notes: All initial16 images were viewed. Long landing/Whats new images were re-opened at original detail after default resizing made phone text too small.
The phone full-page captures include a blank dark tail after the complete visible footer. It does not hide a content section, but should be treated as capture margin rather than site content.
Current changelog starts with0.2.14; canonical55 titles/bodies across7 articles were checked by the root capture workflow, not manually re-proved from image text.
